title: Patient Payment Plans Schedule of Remaining-Term Months on Add-On Extensions
content:
When an add-on lengthens the term of a Patient Payment Plans plan, the extension also carries remaining-term months set by how many installments the plan has left.

| Installments left on the plan | Remaining-term months of the extension |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 6 | 2 |
| At least 6 but fewer than 12 | 1 |
| 12 or more | 0 |

**Schedule rule.** The remaining-term months of the extension are 2 when fewer than 6 installments are left, 1 when at least 6 but fewer than 12 are left, and 0 when 12 or more are left. The installments left are the plan's current term, in monthly installments, less the installments paid on the plan.

**How the months count.** These months are added to the extension months together with the rounded add-on share, and the total is then held within the room left (the tier's maximum term-extension months less the extension months already used) and is never below 0.

**Boundaries (hypothetical plans).**

| Plan's current term | Installments paid | Installments left | Months |
|---|---|---|---|
| 18 | 13 | 5 | 2 |
| 18 | 12 | 6 | 1 |
| 18 | 7 | 11 | 1 |
| 18 | 6 | 12 | 0 |
